title: Ethiopian Injera Pancakes
description: A traditional Ethiopian flatbread, adapted into a delicious and easy-to-make pancake recipe. Perfect for kids and adults alike.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Gradually add water and orange juice, stirring with a wooden spoon until smooth.
The batter should be slightly thick and have a consistency similar to pancake batter.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the injera pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings, such as fruit or honey.
